description: This file implements Base64 VLQ encoding and decoding, used for source map mappings in JavaScript/SCSS preprocessing tooling. It provides methods to encode integers to VLQ-base64 strings and decode such strings back to integers, supporting source map generation and parsing.

classes.name: Base64VLQ
classes.description: A class providing static methods for encoding and decoding integers using Base64 VLQ representation, mainly used in source map generation.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes an integer value into a VLQ-base64 string.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a VLQ-base64 string into an integer value.

methods.name: toVLQSigned
methods.description: Converts a signed integer to a VLQ-signed integer representation.

methods.name: fromVLQSigned
methods.description: Converts a VLQ-signed integer back to a signed integer.
